name: DFRobot SEN0609 mmWave Radar
description: The `dfrobot_sen0609` component lets you use the DFRobot SEN0609 and SEN0610 24GHz mmWave radars (C4001 family) with ESPHome. The radar reports human presence and, in speed and distance mode, the distance, speed and signal energy of a moving target. The SEN0609 has a detection range of up to 25 m and the SEN0610 up to 12 m.

config_entries.label: UART ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [UART](https://esphome.io/components/uart/) to use. Required if you have multiple UARTs configured.

config_entries.label: Model
config_entries.description: The radar model, which sets the largest value of the range [numbers](https://esphome.io/components/dfrobot_sen0609/#number). Defaults to `SEN0609`.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this component. Necessary if you want to define multiple instances of this component.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: The run mode of the radar. Defaults to `presence`.

options.label: presence
options.description: The radar reports whether a person is present.

options.label: speed_and_distance
options.description: The radar reports the distance, speed and energy of a moving target. Needed for the sensors.
